svg.title: Medical RAG E2E Architecture
svg.desc: Two-pipeline diagram: an indexing pipeline on top and a query pipeline below, showing data flow from PDFs through Pinecone to GPT-4o and the Flask UI.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What kind of PDFs should I put in the data/ folder?')
sendPrompt('How does the PDF loader work in this project?')
sendPrompt('What chunking strategy is used in store_index.py?')
sendPrompt('Which HuggingFace embedding model is used?')
sendPrompt('How is the Pinecone serverless index configured?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of medical questions can this chatbot answer?')
sendPrompt('How is the query embedded before retrieval?')
sendPrompt('How does the Pinecone similarity retriever work?')
sendPrompt('How does the LangChain retrieval chain combine context and GPT-4o?')
sendPrompt('Why does this project use GPT-4o specifically?')
sendPrompt('How is the Flask chat UI structured?')
